steps.title: Name the page
steps.body: Inside the body, add an h1 whose text is your name. The heading article shows the shape of the tag. You choose the words.

steps.title: Say something about you
steps.body: Add a paragraph under the heading. One or two sentences is enough.

steps.title: Give it a color
steps.body: In the style block, set a background color on the body. Pick any color you like.
